source_claim: Capcom's official Okami Wii manual has a character section naming Amaterasu and describing the wood sprite Sakuya as a character in the game. These two exact campaign characters have direct HOME in Okami; this batch makes no claim about the other campaign members.
notes: Only the two exact names explicitly covered by the official Capcom manual are included; no inference or terminal review is made for Okikurumi or Ushiwakamaru.
